body:
Adds `research/grasp-twin` (HIRO/CAIRO-adjacent sim-to-real for manipulation; stylised, no real friction data).

- Closed-form optimal grip force under lognormal friction (matches grid and a Coulomb simulation).
- Corner theorem: a deterministic-friction twin grips at its own slip threshold, real drop probability Φ(b/s).
- Randomised-twin real drop law; width compensation shown not to transfer across masses (negative result).
- Exact plug-in inflation of the drop target from n friction measurements, with corrected multiplier.
- README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok; 7 tests pass.
